recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-38741 unless a future tracker changes the diff-page scope or requested breadcrumb/title wording again.
issue_request: FHIR-38741 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for R5. It reported that build.fhir.org/diff.html had breadcrumbs reading 'Foundation > Documentation Index > Differences from Release 3' and requested that the diff-page breadcrumb title refer to Release 4.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 55a127b7c9ee925ca9b05e0a7ff8aa100dd6a9bb, which changed source/diff.html and source/hierarchy.xml from 'Differences from Release 3' to 'Differences from Release 4'.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2022-11-28 record FHIR-38741 as a Technical Correction accepted 8-0-0. Later R6 source work changed the main diff page to 'Differences from Release 4/5' and added version-specific Release 4, Release 4B, and Release 5 to Release 6 diff pages. No current source match for 'Differences from Release 3' remains under source/.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the stale Release 3 breadcrumb/title has already been removed, and the current Release 4/5 wording matches the present R6 diff-page scope better than reverting to only Release 4.
